site.name: Quickler
site.description: Quickler is a WhatsApp field compliance platform for UK trades. Engineers receive compliance questions on WhatsApp; replies and photos generate timestamped PDF reports automatically. Built for EICRs, CP12 gas safety, daily van safety checks, structural site inspection reports, PAT testing, RAMS and toolbox talks.

preferred_flow: read what Quickler does on homepage
read FAQ or workflow page matching the user's use case
submit contact form or start free trial at app.quickler.co/signup

primary_positioning: WhatsApp field compliance reports for UK trades. No app for engineers to install. No per-user subscription. UK data residency.

workflows.name: EICR
workflows.description: Electrical Installation Condition Report — circuit-by-circuit capture on WhatsApp with photo evidence. C1, C2 and FI codes flagged live on dashboard. Formatted EICR PDF for qualifying electrician sign-off.

workflows.name: CP12
workflows.description: Landlord Gas Safety Record — appliance checks on WhatsApp for Gas Safe registered engineers. Formatted CP12 PDF produced automatically.

workflows.name: Van safety checks
workflows.description: DVSA daily walkround on WhatsApp. Defect photos to fleet manager. Red, amber, green status per vehicle live.

workflows.name: Site inspection reports
workflows.description: Structural site notes, photos, sketches and measurements captured on WhatsApp during the visit. Structured draft report ready immediately.

workflows.name: PAT testing
workflows.description: Batch PAT records on WhatsApp. Formatted PAT register and per-item certificate.

workflows.name: RAMS and toolbox talks
workflows.description: RAMS briefings and toolbox talks delivered to operatives on WhatsApp with timestamped acknowledgement.

queries: no per-user compliance app UK trades
